_comment: Full SFT of MOSS-Image-Base at 1024 on trainer_samples_v3 (v1 at 512 degraded quality), fresh from Base, with the MOSS-Image report's final pretraining recipe scaled to our batch: hybrid Muon-AdamW (Muon on block matrices, fused qkv / gate-up split; AdamW betas 0.9/0.95 eps 1e-8 on embeddings, head, time/modulation, 1-D), weight decay 0.01 (none on embeddings / 1-D), clip 1.0, final-block q/k norm decay-to-one 0.01, final-stage timesteps (truncated logit-normal mu -1.09 s 0.95 cutoff 0.95 + 1% uniform, shift 1), EMA (exported). lr 5e-5 at their ~2000 samples/update scaled by sqrt(64/2000) -> 9e-6; EMA 0.9999 (horizon >> our run) -> 0.999 (~1k updates = 64k images); warmup 2000 -> 200 updates. DDP on 2 GPUs x 2 per GPU x accum 16 = 64 images/update; the first 21 of 42 blocks checkpointed (B=2 unchecked peaks at 167 GiB once EMA + Muon momentum are resident), regional compile (static shapes via seq_pad 256), cuDNN attention: the 1024 probe's smallest saturating batch. Rows below 896^2 pixels dropped (no >1.14x upscales).
